description: Use when an agent needs a South Korean company's government contract wins for sales, credit or competitor research. Input: id (companyId) or business_number; optional from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, max 366 days, default last 12 months), category (goods,works,services,foreign), min_amount, limit, offset. Output: JSON summary (award count, total and largest KRW, top agencies) and awards with title, agency, amount, date. Data: KONEPS. Example: ?id=kr-dart-00126380 Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

business_number.description: Business registration number; give id or business_number

category.description: Comma list of goods, works, services, foreign (default all)

from.description: Bid opening date from (default: 365 days before to)

id.description: companyId from /v1/kr/company/resolve; give id or business_number

min_amount.description: Only awards of at least this many KRW

name: kr_company_procurement
title: Korean company public-procurement awards: every KONEPS contract it won, with totals and top agencies
